format: gen4 singles, 6v6, level 100 (Gen IV singles, Blackthorn's standardized terms)
held_constant: A: library:me/heartgold v1 (every field of all 6 builds), played by maxpower
B: library:platinum/cynthia v1 (every field of all 6 builds), played by maxpower
lead order (each team leads with its first member)
varied: battle RNG (damage rolls, accuracy, critical hits, secondary effects, speed ties)
policy RNG (tie-breaks; every choice for a random agent)
sides: A plays p1 in even battles and p2 in odd ones
each pair of battles shares one battle seed with the sides swapped
genders not on record (12 Pokémon): Showdown draws them from the battle seed

log: |rule|HP Percentage Mod: HP is shown in percentages
|rule|Beat Up Nicknames Mod: Beat Up will not reveal any party members
|rule|Endless Battle Clause: Forcing endless battles is banned
